title: Children Having Birthday Picnic Party on Lawn, 1950s Snapshot Photo
description: A group of young neighborhood children sit outdoors on blankets laid over the front lawn next to a residential house, gathered for a celebratory birthday picnic. Several of the boys and girls are wearing small festive party caps or beanies with antenna-like decorations, dressed in vintage early 1950s play clothes and party outfits. In the background, open ground and construction or newly developing tract land reflect the post-WWII American suburban housing boom.
